releases.title: 资源对比按指标分组并明确领先者
releases.summary: 首页与报告解读将 CPU、内存和网络拆为三个指标组，直接标出可按低消耗判断的逐项最低值，并在摘要中说明 Lightpanda 是本轮资源效率领先者。评测证据、任务判定和分母不变。
changes: 资源结论
资源数据平铺在一张宽表中，读者需要自行寻找最低值。
增加资源效率结论卡和 CPU、内存、网络三张关键结果卡，明确 Lightpanda 在本轮低消耗指标中的领先。
资源领先与综合任务通过率分别判断，不合成总分。
逐项比较
表格只突出排序列，没有稳定标记每项最低值。
按计算、内存、网络分组，逐项标记最低消耗；CPU 利用率和传输速率只描述运行形态，不按低值评选。
沿用四种本地方法共同通过的 15/20 个普通网页，不产生新的供应商调用。
发布门禁
资源展示要求依赖人工记忆。
仓库规则和报告检查同时要求首页、解读页及中英文版具备赢家摘要、三类分组和逐项赢家标记。
以后新增或重建报告时缺失任一部分都会阻断发布。

en.title: Group resource comparisons and name the leaders
en.summary: The home page and interpretation split CPU, memory, and network into three metric groups, mark each lower-is-better minimum directly, and identify Lightpanda as the resource-efficiency leader in this run. Evaluation evidence, task verdicts, and denominators are unchanged.
changes: Resource findings
Resource data was spread across one wide table, requiring readers to find minima themselves.
Add a resource-efficiency finding card and three key-result cards for CPU, memory, and network, making Lightpanda's lower-use lead explicit.
Resource leadership and overall task pass rate are judged separately and are not combined into a composite score.
Per-metric comparison
The table highlighted only the sorted column and did not persistently mark each metric's minimum.
Group metrics into compute, memory, and network and mark the lowest use in each; CPU utilization and transfer rates describe runtime behavior and are not ranked by lower values.
Retain the 15/20 general pages passed by all four local methods, with no new provider calls.
Release gate
Resource-presentation requirements depended on manual memory.
Repository rules and report checks now require a winner summary, three grouped sections, and per-metric winner markers on the home and interpretation pages in both languages.
Future report creation or rebuilding is blocked if any of these elements is missing.

releases.title: 增加 CPU、内存、网络实测并收敛 Moli 版本
releases.summary: 当前主报告只保留 Moli 1.1.1，并为四种可本地观测的方法增加统一隔离的 CPU、内存和网络比较。资源结果来自 20 题 × 4 方法的 80 次正式调用，汇总使用共同通过的 15 题。
changes: 当前方法矩阵
三个 Moli 版本同时展示会扩大后续全量重跑和复核范围，也偏离当前产品比较目标。
主报告保留 Kitesurf、Lightpanda、Obscura、Moli 1.1.1、Chromium 五种方法；Moli 1.0.6 和 1.1.3 的历史证据继续保留，但不进入当前页面、分母和榜单。
主矩阵复用已经完成并核验的 750 条五方法结果，没有重新调用供应商；同窗测速的共同成功分母由七配置的 8 题变为当前五配置的 9 题。
资源比较
旧报告只有端到端耗时，无法区分浏览器客户端对 CPU、内存和网络的占用。
预声明 20 个普通网页，单并发运行四种本地方法；每次调用限制为 2 CPU、2 GiB 内存和 512 PID，并保存累计 CPU、内存采样及网络收发计数。
只在四种方法共同通过的 15 题上汇总；失败结果仍保留在逐次证据中但不用于资源排名。
隔离与复用
宿主机进程采样会混入其他任务，旧版成品镜像的 Moli 和 Chromium 版本又与当前口径不一致。
抽出共享的 Linux/cgroup 资源计量与容器限制组件，Web Fetch 每次使用一次性容器和专用网络；Browser Use 复用相同基础计量。固定资源镜像构建一次并按镜像 ID 复用。
现有 Docker 下载层可复用；旧 Moli 1.1.3 和 Chromium 151 成品镜像不冒充当前 Moli 1.1.1 与 Chromium 152。
适用边界
远程 Kitesurf 的客户端请求流量不能代表其浏览器服务端的 CPU、内存和上游网络。
Kitesurf 继续参加正确率和端到端耗时比较，但从资源消耗表中排除并说明原因。
50 ms 采样可能遗漏更短峰值；本轮只能解释 arm64 Linux 隔离容器中的客户端成本。

en.title: Add measured CPU, memory, and network use and narrow the Moli version
en.summary: The current primary report retains only Moli 1.1.1 and adds a uniformly isolated CPU, memory, and network comparison for four locally observable methods. Resource results come from 80 formal calls across 20 tasks × 4 methods, aggregated over the 15 shared passes.
changes: Current method matrix
Showing three Moli versions would expand every future rerun and review and distract from the current product comparison.

The primary report retains Kitesurf, Lightpanda, Obscura, Moli 1.1.1, and Chromium. Historical evidence for Moli 1.0.6 and 1.1.3 remains archived but is excluded from current pages, denominators, and rankings.

The primary matrix reuses 750 completed and reviewed five-method results without new provider calls. Removing the two historical configurations changes the same-window shared-pass denominator from 8 tasks across seven configurations to 9 tasks across the current five.
Resource comparison
The previous report had only end-to-end latency and could not distinguish browser-client CPU, memory, and network use.

20 general pages were predeclared and run one at a time across four local methods. Each call was limited to 2 CPUs, 2 GiB of memory, and 512 PIDs, with cumulative CPU, sampled memory, and network byte counters retained.
Aggregates use only the 15 tasks passed by all four methods. Failed results remain in per-attempt evidence but do not enter the resource ranking.
Isolation and reuse
Host-process sampling can include unrelated work, while the existing finished images use Moli and Chromium versions that do not match the current contract.

Shared Linux/cgroup accounting and container-limit components now serve both evaluations. Web Fetch uses a disposable container and dedicated network per call, while Browser Use reuses the same accounting foundation. The fixed resource image is built once and reused by image ID.
Existing Docker download layers are reusable, but finished images containing Moli 1.1.3 and Chromium 151 are not presented as the current Moli 1.1.1 and Chromium 152 environment.
Scope limits
Kitesurf's local request traffic cannot represent CPU, memory, or upstream network use in its remote browser service.
Kitesurf remains in correctness and end-to-end latency comparisons but is excluded from the resource-use table with the reason disclosed.
Sampling every 50 ms may miss shorter peaks. This run describes only client cost in isolated arm64 Linux containers.

releases.title: 按任务修正官方接口并补齐逐次调用下钻
releases.summary: 十种方法仍执行同一组 150 题，保留 1,500 条权威结果。官方接口修正认证重跑 Cloudflare 23 条、Firecrawl 17 条，共 40 次调用；通过数由 1,024 增至 1,029。document-05 的公共格式归一化零调用增加 1 条通过；Cloudflare 两条视频链接任务又因适配器纠错增加 4 次认证调用。累计 44 次新物理调用，当前通过数 1,032/1,500；Moli 仍为 1.1.4。
changes: Cloudflare 任务接口
原 /markdown 适合网页正文；部分直接 PDF/DOCX 出现接口成功但正文为空，页面图片和视频属性也不能稳定从 Markdown 取得。
网页正文与动态题保留 Browser Run /markdown；直接 PDF/DOCX 上传原文件给 Workers AI /ai/tomarkdown；页面图片和视频地址使用 Browser Run /scrape 的 DOM 属性。下载原文件与转换共用一次端到端预算。
仅替换 Cloudflare 的 7 条直接文档、9 条页面图片和 7 条页面视频结果；/pdf 生成网页 PDF，/links 只列普通链接，/crawl 扩展到其他页面，均不替代这些题的交付物。
Cloudflare 视频地址适配
/scrape 已返回 Blender 的 .mp4.zip 地址和 Bilibili 的 BV 页面入口，旧适配器只接纳常见裸媒体扩展名，因而把目标地址丢掉；放宽后又把普通导航和工具 iframe 误列为视频。
下载包保留 .mp4.zip 形态；视频详情入口仅请求 a[href]，再按视频页面路由筛选，不用标准答案挑选输出。两条受影响任务均按纠正后的接口认证重跑。
video-blender-release 与 video-bilibili-current 最终均通过；Bilibili 输出只含站内 BV 详情地址。中间调用和旧物理证据保留，但不择优进入权威矩阵。
Firecrawl 任务接口
动态题的固定 waitFor 延迟不能执行已声明的顶层选择器条件；页面视频题漏取 Scrape 的 video 字段。
动态题预选 Scrape Actions 的 selector wait；视频资源题同时请求原生 video 格式，并保留正文和资源地址。匹配数量与 iframe 子文档完成条件仍按接口边界披露。
仅替换 10 条动态与 7 条页面视频结果。video 下载入口不等于媒体原字节或画面理解；Search、Crawl 与 Agent 不用于给定 URL 的单页任务。
成绩与同口径分母
只改结果表会掩盖接口和评分入口变化，也会让读者把重新调用与离线复算混为一谈。
40 个方法—题目组合换用官方接口；两条视频链接组合又因适配错误增加 4 次物理调用。44 次新调用完整保留，最终权威矩阵仍只含 40 条新调用结果与 1,460 条原调用结果。document-05 的 Markdown 表格分隔行在公共格式归一化中按排版处理，保存输出离线复评分。
通过数依次为 1,024/1,500、接口纠正后 1,029/1,500、零调用归一化后 1,030/1,500、两条视频适配纠错后 1,032/1,500。分母、150 题、十方法和 Moli 1.1.4 均不变。
核验与资源别名
缩略图可由同一资产的另一 Wikimedia 域名交付，单看主机名会错判 image-04；反过来，无缩略图标识的同名地址也不能任意放行。
40 条新结果和 1,460 条旧结果均有逐条独立核验；最后两条 Cloudflare 输出重新盲审，严格复用身份不变的 1,498 条核验。image-04 按同资产缩略图域名迁移裁决，公共资源规则同时拒绝缺少缩略图标识的近似地址。
当前 1,500/1,500 条权威结果有有效逐条判定核验，未决判定 0。image-04 修正未改变成绩；异常根因调查另有独立门禁。
逐次调用日志
旧详情能看到最终输出，但输出为空时，读者看不到接口状态、最后错误或每次重试的过程。
新物理调用保存脱敏且哈希绑定的请求摘要、接口/进程状态、最后输出、错误与重试记录；详情页按需打开弹窗。完整原始供应商响应仍留在私有证据，不随公开包发布。
本轮全部 40 次新调用有可下钻安全日志；历史调用只展示实际留存字段，并明确标示没有保存的日志，不补造历史 stdout、stderr 或原始信封。

en.title: Correct official routes by task and add per-call drilldown
en.summary: The ten methods still run the same 150 tasks, with 1,500 authoritative results. Official-route corrections certified 23 Cloudflare and 17 Firecrawl calls, 40 in total, raising passes from 1,024 to 1,029. A shared format-normalization correction added 1 document-05 pass without a provider call. Two Cloudflare video-link tasks then required 4 additional certified adapter-correction calls. The release retains 44 new physical calls and now passes 1,032/1,500 tasks; Moli remains at 1.1.4.
changes: Cloudflare routes by task

The former /markdown route suits webpage text. Some direct PDF/DOCX requests returned a successful interface response with empty body text, and page image and video attributes could not be reliably recovered from Markdown.

Web text and dynamic tasks retain Browser Run /markdown. Direct PDF/DOCX files are uploaded to Workers AI /ai/tomarkdown; page image and video URLs come from Browser Run /scrape DOM attributes. Original-file download and conversion share one end-to-end deadline.

Only Cloudflare's 7 direct-document, 9 page-image, and 7 page-video results were replaced. /pdf generates a webpage PDF, /links lists ordinary links, and /crawl expands to other pages; none substitutes for the deliverables in these tasks.
Cloudflare video-URL adaptation

/scrape had returned Blender's .mp4.zip download URL and Bilibili BV detail links, but the old adapter discarded them by requiring a bare media extension. A broad relaxation then mislabeled ordinary navigation and utility iframes as video entries.

The archive route keeps .mp4.zip downloads. Video-detail tasks request only a[href] and filter by video-page URL route, without selecting output against the reference answer. Both affected tasks were certified again under the corrected interface.

video-blender-release and video-bilibili-current both pass in the final matrix; the Bilibili output contains only on-site BV detail URLs. Intermediate and earlier physical calls remain retained but are not selected by score.
Firecrawl routes by task
A fixed waitFor delay could not enforce the declared top-level selector for dynamic tasks; page-video tasks omitted Scrape's video field.

Dynamic tasks preselect Scrape Actions selector waits. Video-resource tasks also request the native video format while retaining text and resource URLs. Match-count and iframe-child completion conditions remain disclosed as interface limits.

Only 10 dynamic and 7 page-video results were replaced. A video download URL is neither original media bytes nor visual understanding. Search, Crawl, and Agent were not used for single-page tasks with a given URL.
Results on the same denominator
Editing only a results table would conceal changes to provider routes and the shared scorer, and blur the distinction between new calls and offline rescoring.

40 method–task pairs use corrected official routes; two video-link pairs added 4 physical adapter-correction calls. All 44 new calls are retained, while the authoritative matrix contains 40 final replacement results and 1,460 inherited results. document-05's Markdown table-divider row is treated as layout by shared normalization and its saved output was rescored offline.

Passes moved from 1,024/1,500 to 1,029/1,500 after route corrections, 1,030/1,500 after zero-call normalization, and 1,032/1,500 after video-adapter corrections. The denominator, 150 tasks, ten methods, and Moli 1.1.4 are unchanged.
Review and resource aliases

A thumbnail of the same asset may be served from another Wikimedia host; comparing hostnames alone would misjudge image-04. A similarly named URL without a thumbnail marker must not be accepted indiscriminately.

All 40 new and 1,460 inherited results have per-attempt independent review. The final two Cloudflare outputs were blindly reviewed again, strictly reusing 1,498 unchanged review identities. image-04 was adjudicated as a same-asset thumbnail-host migration, while the shared resource rule rejects a lookalike URL without the thumbnail path.

All 1,500/1,500 authoritative results have valid per-attempt verdict review, with 0 unresolved verdicts. The image-04 correction did not change scores; root-cause anomaly investigation has a separate gate.
Per-call logs
Earlier detail pages showed final output, but an empty answer did not reveal interface status, the final error, or each retry.

New physical calls retain redacted, hash-bound request summaries, interface/process status, final output, errors, and retry records. The detail page opens this evidence on demand in a dialog. Full raw provider responses remain private and are not included in the public bundle.

All 40 new calls in this release have safe drilldown logs. Older calls show only fields actually retained and explicitly identify unavailable logs; historical stdout, stderr, and raw envelopes are not fabricated.

releases.title: 修复评测全链路根因并设置全矩阵核验门禁
releases.summary: 当前十种方法的 1,500 条主结果已全部独立核验，未决为 0；其中 309 条异常触发结果进一步完成输入、参考、请求、原始响应、适配器、评分器和最终判定七层审查。已修复正文分段、具名链接、脚本状态、文档地标、请求状态、动态卡片边界、公开路径泄漏和参考元数据等共因；仅认证重跑接口或产物身份受影响的声明范围，其余修正复用原始产物离线完成。Moli 保持 1.1.4。
changes: 全量结果核验
上一版只独立审查机器失败，机器通过尚未逐条核验，无法发现被宽松规则放行的系统性假阳性。
机器通过与失败统一使用隐藏机器结论的审查包；任务和审查可见证据哈希均未变化的审查继续有效，只重审发生变化的结果。
当前十方法矩阵审查覆盖 1,500/1,500。修正前审查提出 56 条代理与机器分歧，其中 2 条确认评分错误并先修根因；其余均依据实际产物、标准答案和任务合同裁决，未决为 0。同窗测速只作时延测量，不在结果审查范围。
正文、动态与挑战页评分
旧评分实现可能在代码更新后继续被报告读取；分段正文按参考顺序贪心匹配会让较长实际片段先占用错误区域；序列化脚本状态含目标字符串时又可能被当成可读正文。
报告构建拒绝旧评分实现；正文片段改为全局容量分配且不受参考区域顺序影响；脚本或应用状态壳不能满足正文任务。
两类修正均通过公共 score_attempt 与任务判定入口执行正反向回归；保存输出统一离线重算，不按方法或单条结果增加特例。
Exa 具名链接接口
旧适配器只读取裸 links 数组，既无法证明名称与 URL 的归属，又漏用了官方返回明确 anchor—URL 配对的 richLinks。
仅具名链接任务请求 extras.richLinks，并只接纳 anchor 与 URL 均非空的明确配对；正文标题与裸 links 永不按位置猜配。
接口合同变化只影响 Exa 的 10 个挑战任务，因此通过认证流程重跑该范围；3 条通过、7 条仍因实际产物不满足合同而失败。
DOCX 完整内容
document-05 只要求标题和章节名，导致返回正文叙述却漏掉表格单元格、日历与最终尾注的结果仍可通过。
任务合同增加来自冻结源文档的表格、日历和尾注内容地标；Markdown 表格分隔符按排版处理，不能把完整表格误判失败。
保存产物统一离线复评分：CowAgent 的不完整结果改为失败，Firecrawl 与 Tavily 的完整 Markdown 表格保持通过；不需要重新调用供应商。
图片资源范围
图片地址题一度被拟议成 target-only 输出，可能把已经命中目标、但同时保留页面 Logo 或推荐图的有效抓取误判失败；部分响应式目标别名又需要独立源证据。
资源验收只要求命中任务声明的目标或有证据的合法别名；额外页面图片保留为纯净度诊断，不参与二元通过判定。目标清单、别名、来源观察和资源合同均进入哈希绑定。
避免把页面级抓取强行等同于只返回一个 URL，同时仍拒绝没有命中目标的长文本或大量无关图片；契约变化后旧分数不能发布。
防复发与证据修订
评分、参考、数据集和审查收据可分别更新，若生命周期只校验部分字段，旧核验可能被错误沿用；只改最终判定也无法阻止同类错误复发。
每类根因登记正反向可执行回归；参考修订和评分修订分别串联完整输入输出哈希、根因与回归编号，报告构建校验评分实现、任务内容、资源合同和来源证据。
评分与参考修订不重发 provider 请求；只有接口、版本、输入或请求合同改变的预声明范围才重跑，并保留原调用与新调用的可追溯关系。
Firecrawl 动态接口
旧适配器使用当前账户地区不允许的 actions，10 个动态任务都在服务入口失败，错误地形成 0/10 的能力结论。
改用当前公开接口支持的 waitFor，并通过调用前后参考冻结的认证流程只重跑这 10 个任务；其余 140 条 Firecrawl 结果不变。
新结果 6/10 通过；新增 10 条全部由隐藏机器结论的 Codex CLI 盲审，0 分歧、0 未决。剩余 4 条因实际输出不满足任务合同而失败。
报告阅读与耗时
全部方法共同成功任务的跨批次耗时表默认展开，占据总榜下方较大篇幅；综合总榜没有同时给出完整 150 次调用的时延分布。
共同成功任务耗时改为按需展开；综合总榜新增每种方法全部 150 次调用的均值、P50、P95，和通过率使用相同固定分母。
时延列不参与通过率排序，也不选择成功子集；失败调用耗时保留在全调用分布中。
请求状态与空输出
旧适配器把供应商调用成功但没有可验收正文，与供应商或目标请求失败混成同一种失败，导致请求成功率与任务通过率语义串线。
Cloudflare 依据保存的 success、result 与 origin status 信封归一化；Moli 依据 1.1.4 的退出状态和完整响应错误信封归一化。空的成功响应仍是请求成功、任务失败；明确的目标非 2xx 仍是请求失败。
14 条状态修正均由哈希绑定的原始证据离线重建，任务判定和分数不变，无 provider 调用。
动态提取与公开产物
Crawl4AI 动态购物车请求声明了限定提取，但 worker 未传入对应配置并丢失卡片边界；OpenClaw 错误堆栈和 CowAgent 保存提示又会把本机路径带入公开证据。
Crawl4AI worker 传入已声明的提取配置并保留卡片间边界；OpenClaw/DeepSeek 错误面只保留稳定消息，CowAgent 仅删除本机保存路径而保留抓取正文。
Crawl4AI 该题认证重跑后通过，方法总分增至 119/150；OpenClaw 15 条和 CowAgent 11 条受影响产物认证重跑，任务总分不变，公开产物不再包含真实主机路径。
参考证据一致性
四个完整正文样本的来源说明曾错误指向其他网站；NOAA 样本已有当日独立 200 响应、main 区域和完整正文哈希，却保留了“全文不可用”的旧备注。
完整正文来源必须与题目 URL 同站；NOAA 元数据改为明确记录完整参考可用，稳定锚点继续决定二元验收，全文快照只提供诊断指标。新增数据集门禁拒绝有效全文与不可用声明并存。
来源与备注修正不改变 provider 输出或任务分数；相关结果重新绑定并独立复核。
异常根因门禁
仅比较标准答案与最终判定无法主动发现空输出、跨站相同错误、集中零分、接口误用、参考冲突和公开产物泄漏；按批次序号缓存又会在小修后错配审查结果。
逐条盲审之后，对确定性异常信号执行七层调查；异常缓存按精确 attempt 范围而不是批次位置复用，范围变化时只重审变化组。
最终矩阵 1,500/1,500 已核验，309 条异常触发结果全部完成调查，未决 0；缓存范围、参考修订和最终审查均有哈希绑定。

en.title: Fix root causes across the evaluation chain and require full-matrix review
en.summary: All 1,500 primary results across ten methods were independently reviewed with 0 unresolved decisions. The 309 anomaly-triggered results also completed seven-layer review covering input, reference, request, raw response, adapter, scorer, and final verdict. Shared fixes cover body segmentation, named links, script-state text, document landmarks, request status, dynamic-card boundaries, public path leakage, and reference metadata. Only declared scopes whose interface or artifact identity changed were rerun; all other corrections reused saved outputs offline. Moli remains on 1.1.4.
changes: Full result review
The previous release independently reviewed machine failures only. Machine passes had not been checked individually, leaving systematic false positives from permissive rules undetectable.

Machine passes and failures use the same packets with machine judgments hidden. Prior reviews remain valid only when both the task and reviewer-visible evidence hash are unchanged; only changed results are reviewed again.

Review covers 1,500/1,500 results in the current ten-method matrix. Before correction, the reviewer raised 56 disagreements with machine judgments; 2 confirmed scoring errors whose root causes were fixed first, and the remainder were adjudicated against actual artifacts, reference answers, and task contracts. There are 0 unresolved items. The same-window cohort remains latency-only and is outside result review.
Body, dynamic-task, and challenge-page scoring

A report could keep reading stale scorer output after code changes; greedy body matching in reference order could let longer returned fragments consume the wrong region first; and serialized script state containing target strings could be mistaken for readable body text.
Report builds reject stale scorer output; body fragments now use global capacity allocation independent of reference-region order; and script or application-state shells cannot satisfy body tasks.

Both corrections have positive and negative regressions executed through the shared score_attempt and task-decision paths. Saved output is consistently rescored offline without provider-specific or row-specific exceptions.
Exa named-link interface
The old adapter read only the bare links array, which could not prove name-to-URL ownership and omitted official richLinks with explicit anchor–URL pairs.
Only named-link tasks request extras.richLinks, and only explicit pairs with nonempty anchors and URLs are accepted. Body headings and bare links are never paired by position.
The interface-contract change affects only Exa's 10 challenge tasks, so the certified rerun was limited to that scope. 3 pass; 7 still fail because the actual artifacts do not satisfy the contract.
Complete DOCX content
document-05 required only the title and section names, allowing narrative output that omitted table cells, calendar content, and the final notes to pass.
The task contract now includes table, calendar, and note landmarks from the frozen source document. Markdown table separators are treated as layout so complete tables are not falsely rejected.
Saved artifacts were consistently rescored offline: CowAgent's incomplete result now fails, while Firecrawl and Tavily retain passes for complete Markdown tables. No provider calls were needed.
Image-resource scope

Image-URL tasks were briefly proposed as target-only output, which could fail a valid page fetch that found the target while retaining logos or recommendation images. Some responsive target aliases also require independent source evidence.

Resource acceptance requires a declared target or an evidenced valid alias. Additional page images remain a precision diagnostic and do not affect binary acceptance. Target lists, aliases, source observations, and resource contracts are all hash-bound.

This avoids treating a page-level fetch as if it had to return only one URL, while still rejecting long text or many unrelated images that never match the target. Stale scores cannot be published after a contract change.
Recurrence prevention and evidence revision

Scores, references, datasets, and review receipts can change independently. Partial lifecycle validation could wrongly reuse an old review, while patching only a final verdict cannot prevent recurrence.

Each root cause has executable controls in both directions. Reference and scoring revisions separately chain complete input and output hashes, root causes, and regression IDs; report builds validate scorer identity, task content, resource contracts, and source evidence.

Scoring and reference revisions do not resend provider requests. Only predeclared scopes affected by an interface, version, input, or request-contract change are rerun, with traceability preserved between old and new calls.
Firecrawl dynamic interface
The old adapter used actions, which the current account region does not allow. All 10 dynamic tasks failed at the service boundary, incorrectly producing a 0/10 capability result.

The adapter now uses waitFor, supported by the current public interface. A certified run with references frozen before and after calls reran only these 10 tasks; the other 140 Firecrawl results are unchanged.

The new results pass 6/10. Codex CLI blindly reviewed all 10 additions with machine judgments hidden, finding 0 disagreements and 0 unresolved items. The remaining 4 fail because their actual output does not satisfy the task contract.
Report reading and latency
The cross-batch latency table for tasks passed by every method was expanded by default and occupied substantial space below the ranking; the overall ranking did not show latency over all 150 calls.
Shared-success latency is now collapsed on demand. The overall ranking adds mean, P50, and P95 over all 150 calls per method, using the same fixed denominator as coverage.
Latency columns do not affect coverage ordering or select a successful subset; failed-call elapsed time remains in the all-call distribution.
Request status and empty output
The old adapters conflated a successful provider call with no acceptable body and a provider or target request failure, mixing request-success and task-pass semantics.

Cloudflare now normalizes saved success, result, and origin-status envelopes; Moli uses the 1.1.4 exit status and whole-response error envelope. An empty successful response remains request success but task failure, while an explicit target non-2xx remains request failure.
All 14 status corrections were reconstructed offline from hash-bound raw evidence. Task verdicts and scores did not change, and no provider was called.
Dynamic extraction and public artifacts

The Crawl4AI dynamic-cart request declared bounded extraction, but the worker did not pass the configuration and lost card boundaries. OpenClaw error stacks and CowAgent save notices could also expose host-local paths in public evidence.

The Crawl4AI worker now passes the declared extraction configuration and preserves card boundaries. OpenClaw and DeepSeek error surfaces retain only stable messages, while CowAgent removes only host-local save paths and keeps fetched text.

The certified Crawl4AI rerun passes and raises its total to 119/150. Certified reruns covered 15 affected OpenClaw artifacts and 11 CowAgent artifacts without changing their task totals; public artifacts no longer contain real host paths.
Reference-evidence consistency

Four complete-body samples had source descriptions pointing to unrelated sites. The NOAA sample had a same-day independent 200 response, main-region extraction, and complete-body hash but retained a stale note saying the full text was unavailable.

Complete-body evidence must use the task URL's site. NOAA metadata now explicitly records the complete reference as available; stable anchors still drive binary acceptance and the full snapshot supplies diagnostic metrics. A dataset guard rejects valid full text paired with an unavailable declaration.
Source and note corrections do not change provider output or task scores; affected results were rebound and independently reviewed.
Anomaly root-cause gate

Comparing only a reference and final verdict cannot proactively find empty output, repeated cross-site errors, concentrated zero scores, interface misuse, reference conflicts, or public-artifact leakage. Caching by batch number also misaligns reviews after small revisions.

After row-level blind review, deterministic anomaly signals receive a seven-layer investigation. Anomaly caches are reused by exact attempt scope rather than batch position, so only changed groups are reviewed again.
The final matrix is reviewed 1,500/1,500; all 309 anomaly-triggered results completed investigation with 0 unresolved items. Cache scope, reference revisions, and final review are hash-bound.

releases.title: 完成十二方法升级、影响范围重跑与失败项核验
releases.summary: 十二方法报告已重新绑定当前评测集、实现身份和独立发布目标。主矩阵按预声明影响范围新增 432 次调用，同窗测速新增 240 次；主矩阵 705 条机器失败结果完成独立核验，1,095 条机器通过结果未逐条审查，分歧逐条裁决，未决为 0。
changes: 评测对象
默认报告一度指向七种浏览器方法，旧十二方法页面又保留了已替换的易变正文样本，无法作为本轮十二方法权威矩阵。
当前 profile 恢复十二种 Web Fetch 方法和 150 个任务；八个易变全文样本改为 RFC、固定 Git 提交、W3C 定版文档或 Wikipedia 固定修订，并保留明确的替换关系。
最终权威矩阵仍为 1,800 个方法—任务逻辑结果；被替换题目及另外五个受参考或实现影响的题目须按当前合同重跑，旧结果不直接沿用。
实现身份与前置门禁
旧证据没有完整固定 CowAgent、OpenClaw、DeepSeek Harness、LangChain 与 Crawl4AI 的源码或依赖身份，空路径或错误版本还可能在证据目录创建后才失败。
源码型方法固定仓库修订、Node 版本和必需文件；LangChain WebBaseLoader 0.3.30、Crawl4AI 0.9.3 及文档解析依赖进入 uv.lock。所有方法在创建运行证据前完成身份、命令和路径校验，身份摘要写入 manifest。
LangChain 与 Crawl4AI 因旧权威证据未记录库版本，各自完整重跑 150 题；源码型方法只有精确且干净的绑定实现进入本轮。
直接文档路线
通用 Moli 适配器把直接 PDF 或 DOCX 正文任务当作普通网页 Markdown，可能在取得原始文档前失败或把二进制响应序列化。
直接 PDF、DOCX 与文件任务预先选择 Moli 自动原始响应；正文任务在同一个 45 秒预算内解析文字并保留原始字节哈希，文件任务继续按字节验收，不增加跨方法下载后备。
受路线影响的文档结果已进入声明的重跑范围；评分与盲审均使用新保存输出。
偶发下载证据
正文抓取若同时触发浏览器下载，旧 runner 因二进制没有文件任务验收记录而中止整批，导致后续结果缺失。
调用边界现在会保存并哈希所有返回字节；只有文件任务可用这些字节通过验收，正文任务仍必须交付合格文字。触发故障的 Crawl4AI 批次已整批作废并重跑。
修复只保证证据完整和运行可继续，不把偶发下载当成正文能力，也不复用崩溃前的部分批次。
影响范围与测速
仅补跑旧失败或只重建页面会混入未知实现版本，也无法公平比较来自不同批次的十二方法耗时。
主矩阵预先声明 13 题 × 12 方法、LangChain 与 Crawl4AI 的其余完整方法 cohort，以及两个超时边界修正，共完成 432 次新调用；另以 provider-blind、域名去重的 20 题完成 240 次十二方法同窗测速。
主矩阵固定每个方法—任务一个权威逻辑结果，不按最好或最快挑选。测速保留完整预声明矩阵：全调用延迟按同一 20 题分母统计，成功调用延迟另作条件统计；十二方法共同通过为 1/20，只作为诊断，不据此筛样本或排名。
证据与失败项核验
旧组装器可能把 worker 工作树和符号链接带入汇总，又会漏掉重试物理调用返回的辅助文件；审查包若遗漏原生答案字段，也会制造系统性假分歧。
汇总只复制哈希绑定的公开文件，拒绝符号链接和工作树路径，并绑定主返回、辅助文件与每次物理重试。Codex gpt-5.6-sol 对主矩阵 705 条机器失败结果盲审，审查包同时提供白名单化的原生答案 metadata；2 条分歧逐条裁决。
最终证据为 12 × 150 的唯一主矩阵和 12 × 20 的唯一测速矩阵；主矩阵失败项核验 705/705，机器通过未逐条审查 1,095 条，测速结果不在本次审查范围，未决 0。裁决只确定审计结论，不回写或择优替换 provider 输出。
报告与发布隔离
旧生成器混用了 150 题、六类和七浏览器专属叙述，方法页重复 Exa、Tavily、Firecrawl 配置，通用报告还可能显示 headless 修订史、复现链接和中文延迟加载提示。
同一 renderer 改由当前 dataset、records 和实际收据生成数量、方法路线、修订说明与链接；十二方法与 headless 历史按 comparison kind 隔离，中英文虚拟路由分别显示对应加载及无障碍文案。当前十二方法构建绑定新的 dev 域站点，旧十二方法站点与 app 域浏览器参考报告保持不变。
发布器逐文件核验公开文件；服务端允许的 HTML 外壳注入与匿名字节一致性分层披露，不再把两者混称为全站字节相同。
环境导入
托管方法凭据已存在于用户级 ~/.env，但旧流程只读取仓库 .env，导致新会话会误报缺少变量。
新增显式 import-env：仅将九个允许变量从用户级文件补入仓库 .env，保留已有非空值、隐藏变量内容并强制 0600 权限；文档和测试固定该入口。
凭据值仍不进入 Git、证据、日志或报告；导入后六个托管方法的前置校验通过。

en.title: Complete the twelve-method upgrade, impact-scoped reruns, and failure review
en.summary: The twelve-method report is now bound to the current evaluation set, implementation identities, and an independent publication target. The primary matrix adds 432 calls within the predeclared impact scope and the same-window latency cohort adds 240 calls. All 705 machine failures in the primary matrix received independent review; the 1,095 machine passes were not reviewed individually. Every disagreement was adjudicated, with 0 unresolved.
changes: Evaluation scope

The default report had temporarily pointed to the seven browser methods, while the old twelve-method site still contained volatile body-text tasks that have since been replaced. Neither could serve as the authoritative twelve-method matrix for this run.

The current profile restores twelve Web Fetch methods and 150 tasks. Eight volatile full-text tasks are replaced with RFCs, pinned Git commits, final W3C publications, or a fixed Wikipedia revision, with each replacement recorded explicitly.

The final authoritative matrix remains 1,800 logical method–task results. The replaced tasks and five additional tasks affected by reference or implementation changes must be rerun under the current contract; their old results are not carried forward directly.
Implementation identity and preflight gates

The old evidence did not fully pin the source or dependency identities for CowAgent, OpenClaw, DeepSeek Harness, LangChain, and Crawl4AI. Empty paths or incorrect versions could also fail only after an evidence directory had been created.

Source-backed methods now pin repository revisions, Node versions, and required files. LangChain WebBaseLoader 0.3.30, Crawl4AI 0.9.3, and document-parsing dependencies are locked in uv.lock. Every method validates its identity, command, and paths before run evidence is created, and an identity summary is written to the manifest.

LangChain and Crawl4AI each reran all 150 tasks because the previous authoritative evidence did not record their library versions. For source-based methods, only exact, clean, bound implementations entered this run.
Direct-document path
The general Moli adapter treated direct PDF and DOCX body-text tasks as ordinary web Markdown, which could fail before retrieving the original document or serialize a binary response.

Direct PDF, DOCX, and file tasks now preselect Moli's automatic raw response. Body-text tasks parse text within the same 45-second budget and retain the raw-byte hash; file tasks continue to be accepted by byte validation, with no cross-method download fallback.
Document results affected by the route change were included in the declared rerun scope; scoring and blind review both use the newly saved outputs.
Incidental-download evidence
When a body fetch also triggered a browser download, the old runner aborted the whole batch because the binary had no file-task evaluation record, leaving later results missing.

The call boundary now persists and hashes every returned binary. Only file tasks may pass on those bytes; body tasks must still deliver acceptable text. The affected Crawl4AI batch was invalidated in full and rerun.
This fix preserves evidence and lets execution continue; it neither treats an incidental download as body capability nor reuses the partial pre-crash batch.
Impact scope and latency cohort

Rerunning only old failures or merely rebuilding the pages would mix unknown implementation versions and would not support a fair latency comparison across twelve methods measured in different batches.

The primary matrix predeclared 13 tasks × 12 methods, the remaining full-method cohorts for LangChain and Crawl4AI, and two deadline-boundary corrections, for 432 new calls in total. A separate provider-blind, domain-deduplicated set of 20 tasks produced 240 same-window latency calls across all twelve methods.

The primary matrix fixes one authoritative logical result for every method–task pair and never selects the best or fastest result. The latency cohort retains its complete predeclared matrix: all-call latency uses the same 20-task denominator, while successful-call latency is reported separately as a conditional statistic. All twelve methods jointly passed 1/20 tasks; this is diagnostic only and is not used to select samples or rank methods.
Evidence and failure review

The old assembler could pull worker trees and symbolic links into the aggregate while omitting auxiliary files returned by physical retry calls. A review packet that omitted native answer fields could also create systematic false disagreements.

Aggregation now copies only hash-bound public files, rejects symbolic links and worker-tree paths, and binds the primary response, auxiliary files, and every physical retry. Codex gpt-5.6-sol blindly reviewed the 705 machine failures in the primary matrix, with allowlisted native answer metadata included in the review packet; the 2 disagreements were adjudicated individually.

The final evidence consists of one 12 × 150 primary matrix and one 12 × 20 latency matrix. Failure review covers 705/705 primary-matrix failures; 1,095 machine passes were not reviewed individually, and latency results were outside this review scope. There are 0 unresolved items. Adjudication determines only the audit conclusion and never rewrites or selectively replaces provider output.
Report and publication isolation

The old generator mixed fixed 150-task and six-family copy with seven-browser-specific explanations. Method pages repeated Exa, Tavily, and Firecrawl configuration, while the general report could also show headless changelog entries, reproduction links, and Chinese lazy-loading messages.

The shared renderer now derives counts, method paths, revision explanations, and links from the current dataset, records, and available receipts. Twelve-method and headless histories are separated by comparison kind, and Chinese and English virtual routes show localized loading and accessibility copy. The current twelve-method build is bound to a new dev-domain site, while the old twelve-method site and the app-domain browser reference report remain unchanged.

The publisher verifies public files individually. Server-permitted HTML shell injection and anonymous byte equality are disclosed as separate layers rather than being conflated as site-wide byte identity.
Environment import
Credentials for hosted methods already existed in the user-level ~/.env, but the old workflow read only the repository .env, causing new sessions to report variables as missing incorrectly.

An explicit import-env command now copies only nine allowlisted variables from the user-level file into the repository .env, preserves existing non-empty values, hides variable contents, and enforces 0600 permissions. Documentation and tests make this the stable entry point.
Credential values still never enter Git, evidence, logs, or the report. Preflight validation passes for all six hosted methods after import.

changes: 耗时比较
首屏强调秒数，读者需要自行计算差距。
用未舍入数据计算相对 Chromium 的耗时减少比例：均值 42.8%、P50 46.7%、P95 44.3%，秒数作为次要依据保留。

增加结果总览、Web Fetch 与 Browser Use 对照、五种交付物流程图；提供完整图片下载，英文版使用对应英文总览。

en.title: Emphasize latency reduction and add three explanatory figures
en.summary: The opening compares mean, P50, and P95 latency reductions against Chromium. A result overview and two flow diagrams replace repeated summaries and some process prose, with direct descriptive titles.
changes: Latency comparison
The opening emphasized seconds and required readers to calculate the differences themselves.
Use unrounded values to calculate reductions relative to Chromium: 42.8% for mean latency, 46.7% for P50, and 44.3% for P95, while retaining seconds as secondary context.

Explanatory figures

Add a result overview, a Web Fetch versus Browser Use comparison, and a flow diagram for five deliverable types. Full-size images are downloadable, with a corresponding English overview.
The diagrams are explanatory. Six case groups still show original evidence; images are reviewed and hash-bound but do not affect scoring.

changes: 结果展示
