原报告的同窗测速章节与证据继续保留，未删除或改写调用记录。
阅读结构
章节眉题、副标题和浏览器长段落增加阅读负担。
统一编号标题和字号层级，以对照表介绍五款浏览器，增加量化总结与有序后续计划。
保留 Web Fetch、Browser Use 背景、五类流程和六组真实案例。

en.title: Interpretation opens with overall pass rates and six task groups
en.summary: The five-browser article opens with overall pass rates and results for six task groups, explains the differences in the body, and closes with findings. Browser configurations use a comparison table, with consistently numbered sections.
changes: Result presentation
Overall pass rates and group results were spread throughout the article.
The opening brings together overall pass rates and six group pass counts for the five browsers, followed by explanations of document, media, and web differences.
The same 150 tasks and Moli 1.1.1 are retained; scores and pass counts are unchanged.
Latency presentation
The article expanded two latency comparisons under different conditions, dividing the reading flow.
The article focuses on mean latency, P50, and P95 for all 98 shared successful main tasks, retaining the collection-across-batches condition.
The original report retains its same-window latency section and evidence; call records are neither deleted nor rewritten.
Reading structure
Section eyebrows, subtitles, and long browser paragraphs added reading overhead.
Use consistently numbered headings and type sizes, introduce the five browsers in a comparison table, and add quantified findings and an ordered follow-up plan.
Retain Web Fetch and Browser Use background, five workflow types, and real examples from six groups.

releases.title: 增加五浏览器 Web Fetch 图文解读
releases.summary: 文章对比 Moli 1.1.1 与另外四款浏览器，明确 150 题中通过 135 题，完整展示均值、P50、P95，并用六个评测集的可切换案例并列标准答案与真实输出。原始调用、评分及榜单分母不变。
changes: 加载恢复
短暂网络失败后，失败缓存使页面内重试无法重新请求。
清除失败缓存，为页面和证据内容提供重新加载入口。
仅修复报告读取行为，原始输出与评分不变。
文章范围
多版本结果与案例细节分散，难以独立理解 Moli 1.1.1 的表现。
从同一证据生成五浏览器结果图、120/30 题分解、PDF 路径与媒体案例；明确 Moli 1.1.1 为看到版本结果后的选择。
正文展示五种方法的 750 条结果；完整七路线 1,050 条证据保留，不逐题选择版本。
结论依据
总通过数不能说明差距来自何种输入。
展示 Moli 与 Chromium 在 120 个网页任务中同为 111 题，30 个文档与媒体任务分别完成 24、14 题。
PDF 结论包含本地解析器；文件校验不测媒体语义；98 道共同成功主任务的耗时跨批次；五款同窗测速使用全部 9 道共同成功题，不改变原七配置测速结果。
阅读格式
报告表格不便直接用于长文阅读。
集成文章和独立 HTML 共用正文、内联图形与样式，适配手机和打印。
仅更新展示与解释，无新增供应商调用，无分数或耗时更改。
验收解释
五类任务原先只有概念流程，难以核对具体通过原因。
普通网页、动态网页、热门站点、文档、图片、视频各取一个案例，逐项核对独立参考与真实返回；保留原始 PNG，关键数字直接排版。
明确结构检查不核验商品名称事实、文件长度门槛为 32 字节，以及正文规则经过统一离线修订。

en.title: Add an illustrated five-browser Web Fetch interpretation
en.summary: The article compares Moli 1.1.1 with four other browsers, states that it passed 135 of 150 tasks, presents mean latency, P50, and P95, and provides selectable examples from six dataset groups pairing references with actual outputs. Original calls, scores, and ranking denominators are unchanged.
changes: Loading recovery
After a temporary network failure, cached failures prevented in-page retries from making a new request.
Clear cached failures and provide reload controls for pages and evidence content.
Only report loading behavior changes; original outputs and scores are unchanged.
Article scope
Results across versions and scattered case details made it difficult to understand Moli 1.1.1's performance independently.
Generate five-browser charts, a 120/30-task breakdown, a PDF path, and media examples from the same evidence; disclose that Moli 1.1.1 was selected after seeing version results.
The article presents 750 results from five methods; all 1,050 records across seven paths remain available, without task-by-task version selection.
Basis for conclusions
The total pass count does not explain which input types contribute to the difference.
Show that, across 120 web tasks, Moli and Chromium each complete 111; across 30 document and media tasks, they complete 24 and 14 respectively.

PDF results include the local parser; file checks do not assess media semantics. Latency for the 98 shared successful main tasks spans batches. The five-browser same-window comparison uses all 9 shared successes, without changing the original seven-configuration latency results.
Reading format
Report tables were not convenient for long-form reading.
The integrated article and standalone HTML share body text, inline graphics, and styles, with mobile and print layouts.
Presentation and explanation changes only: no new provider calls and no score or latency changes.
Acceptance explained
The five task types previously had only conceptual flows, making the reasons for passing difficult to check.

One example each from general pages, dynamic pages, popular sites, documents, images, and videos compares independent references with actual outputs check by check. The original PNG is retained and key figures are rendered directly as text.
Clarify that structural checks do not verify product-name facts, the file-length threshold is 32 bytes, and body rules received shared offline revisions.

releases.title: 说明按需发布架构，补全安装清单与公开安全门禁
releases.summary: 报告明确区分逻辑路由与线上物理文件，补齐双语入口、七种方法的安装清单和公开安全门禁；同时按固定最终轮纠正四题、三个 Moli 版本的 12 个异常耗时。任务输出、判定和分数不变，延迟汇总已重算。
changes: 发布架构
把 1,218 个可审计页面称为线上 HTML 文件，容易误解为重复部署并一次性加载。
明确本地构建产出逻辑路由，Sites 包使用单个 HTML 外壳、共享运行时和内容寻址压缩块，页面与大证据按需加载。
发布清单记录逻辑路由、源文件、压缩块和逐文件哈希；不减少证据，也不改变下载字节。
账号与安装
旧页只显示唯一需要供应商账号的 Cloudflare，导致本地方法的取得方式和二进制配置看似消失。
页面改为账号与安装清单：Cloudflare 列账号与凭据变量，其余六种本地方法列官方获取入口和二进制变量。
只公开变量名称和官方入口，不保存值、本机路径、Cookie 或个人会话。
核验标识
榜单只写已核验，读者无法直接看出核验主体。
各方法审查列显示 100/100 · Codex 已核验，并继续链接到统一核验记录。
只改展示文案；核验绑定、覆盖数和未决数不变。
中英版本
原英文入口只是单页摘要，路由、章节和逐次证据解释均未与中文报告对齐。
从同一报告模型生成逐页对应的中英文站点；导航按评测集、方法、分析、核验、解读、实现、复现、变更、安装排序，语言切换停留在当前路由。
两种语言的路由、章节、表格、数值、筛选器和证据链接一一校验；界面与解释按英文语境改写，任务名、ID、URL、标准答案和原始输出保持原文且不重新评分。
公开安全门禁
原发布扫描覆盖 Google、Artifact Hub、GitHub 与 OpenAI 等常见密钥形态，但未明确拦截 Authorization 值、本机用户目录、AWS 与 Slack 凭据。
统一扫描每个重建后的公开文件，新增 Authorization、用户目录、AWS、Slack 和私钥形态检查；第三方 HTML 的既有 Google 形态脱敏仍保留双哈希。
模式扫描不能证明不存在所有未知秘密；结构化凭据值仍禁止进入证据和报告，发布后还要逐文件字节复核。
Moli 时延纠正
少量旧耗时异常会让 1.1.3 看起来存在未经证明的整体性能回退。
对同一四题、三个版本做三轮轮换，统一采用第三轮的 12 个耗时并重算均值、P50、P95；不按结果择优。
全部通过任务中，1.1.3 的均值由 4,000 降至 3,706 ms、P50 由 3,444 降至 3,340 ms、P95 由 9,833 降至 7,983 ms；1.0.6 与 1.1.1 也按同一规则更新。共保留 36 次物理调用；正文、评分和任务判定未改变。

en.title: Document on-demand publishing, complete setup guidance, and strengthen the public-release security gate
en.summary: The report now distinguishes logical routes from deployed physical files and adds route-aligned bilingual access, setup instructions for all seven methods, and a stronger public-release security gate. It also corrects 12 anomalous latency values across four tasks and three Moli versions using one fixed final round. Task outputs, verdicts, and scores are unchanged; latency aggregates were recomputed.
changes: Publishing architecture
Calling 1,218 auditable routes deployed HTML files suggested duplicated deployment and eager loading.
Clarified that the local build produces logical routes, while the Sites bundle uses one HTML shell, a shared runtime, and content-addressed compressed blocks; pages and large evidence load on demand.
The publication manifest records logical routes, source files, compressed blocks, and per-file hashes. Evidence is not reduced and download bytes do not change.
Access & setup
The old page showed only Cloudflare, the sole provider account requirement, making acquisition and binary configuration for local methods appear to be missing.
Changed the page to an access and installation checklist: Cloudflare lists account and credential variables, while the six local methods list official acquisition sources and binary variables.
Publish only variable names and official sources; never retain values, local paths, cookies, or personal sessions.
Review attribution
The ranking said only that results were reviewed, without identifying the reviewer.
Each method's review column now shows 100/100 · reviewed by Codex and continues to link to the shared review record.
Presentation copy only; review bindings, coverage, and unresolved counts are unchanged.
Chinese and English editions
The former English entry was a one-page summary whose routes, sections, and per-attempt evidence explanations did not align with the Chinese report.

Generate route-aligned Chinese and English sites from the same report model. Navigation follows dataset, methodology, analysis, review, interpretation, methods, reproduction, changelog, and setup; switching language stays on the current route.

Validate one-to-one parity for routes, sections, tables, values, filters, and evidence links. UI and explanations are rewritten for natural English, while task names, IDs, URLs, reference answers, and raw outputs remain unchanged and are not rescored.
Public-release security gate

The previous release scan covered common Google, Artifact Hub, GitHub, and OpenAI key patterns, but did not explicitly block Authorization values, local user-directory paths, or AWS and Slack credentials.

Every rebuilt public file is now scanned uniformly, adding checks for Authorization values, user-directory paths, AWS and Slack credentials, and private-key patterns. Existing redaction of Google-shaped secrets in third-party HTML retains both hashes.
Pattern scanning cannot prove that every unknown secret is absent. Structured credential values remain prohibited in evidence and reports, and published files still require byte-level verification.
Moli latency correction
A few anomalous legacy latency values made 1.1.3 appear to have an unproven overall performance regression.
Run three order-rotated rounds for the same four tasks and three versions, use the 12 third-round latency values uniformly, and recompute mean, P50, and P95 without selecting favorable results.

Across passing tasks, the 1.1.3 mean fell from 4,000 to 3,706 ms, P50 from 3,444 to 3,340 ms, and P95 from 9,833 to 7,983 ms. Versions 1.0.6 and 1.1.1 were updated under the same rule. All 36 physical calls are retained; body text, scores, and task verdicts are unchanged.

releases.title: 统一方法组合对比，补充 Moli 时延诊断
releases.summary: 结果分析页改为一个可同时处理双方法和多方法的对比器，并重新排版任务与结果；issue #66 的回退线索经公网顺序轮换与本地固定页对照后，保留为未能单因归因的长尾现象。正式任务、分数和耗时不变。
changes: 统一对比器
双方法与多方法拆成两张大卡和两份结果表，控制项重复、页面拥挤。
保留一个方法 A、可多选对比方法和一组统一关系条件；结果只渲染一张同题表。
支持有分歧、A 成功或失败、全部成功或失败、仅所选方法成功；不生成新分数。
结果排版
双栏压缩了任务类型和方法列，中文类型被逐字换行，横向阅读困难。
组件改为全宽；任务类型并入任务单元格徽标，成功与失败方法用可换行状态标签展示。
窄屏仍允许表格横向滚动，任务名称、ID 和证据链接完整保留。
Moli 时延线索
正式单次结果显示 1.1.3 在少数任务上明显慢于旧版，但无法区分版本、网络和页面等待。
选择四个差异大的不同路径任务做三轮轮换复测，再用本地固定页各五轮测固定开销。
公网各题中位数有快有慢且波动区间重叠；本地固定开销未见 1.1.3 回退，因此不把 issue #66 升格为已确认回归。
纠正与失败重试
把所有后续调用都禁止掉会让已证实的错误无法纠正；反过来，失败后挑选更好响应又会制造 best-of 偏差。
区分两条路径：错误命令、版本、裁判或参考按明确范围 supersede 并重测；普通失败可在测量前声明最多重试一次，保留两次物理证据且最后一次无条件生效。
当前 1,050 条结果没有启用重试，issue #66 的诊断复测也不替换正式结果；后续协议可按需启用。

en.title: Unify method-combination comparisons and add Moli latency diagnostics
en.summary: The analysis page now uses one comparator for both two-method and multi-method comparisons, with a clearer task-and-result layout. After rotating request order on the public web and checking against a fixed local page, the regression signal in issue #66 remains a long-tail effect that cannot be attributed to a single cause. Official tasks, scores, and latency values are unchanged.
changes: Unified comparator
Two-method and multi-method comparisons were split across two large cards and two result tables, duplicating controls and crowding the page.
Keep one method A selector, a multi-select for comparison methods, and one shared set of relationship filters; render only one matched-task result table.
Supports disagreements, A passing or failing, all methods passing or failing, and only the selected methods passing; no new score is produced.
Result layout
The two-column layout squeezed the task-family and method columns, wrapping Chinese family names one character at a time and making horizontal reading difficult.
The component now uses the full width. Task family appears as a badge inside the task cell, and passing and failing methods appear as wrapping status labels.
The table can still scroll horizontally on narrow screens, while task names, IDs, and evidence links remain complete.
Moli latency signal
The official single-run results show 1.1.3 markedly slower than earlier versions on a few tasks, but cannot separate version effects from network and page-wait effects.
Retest four high-difference tasks on distinct paths in three rotating rounds, then use five rounds per version on a fixed local page to measure fixed overhead.
Per-task medians on the public web move in both directions and have overlapping ranges. Fixed local overhead shows no 1.1.3 regression, so issue #66 is not promoted to a confirmed regression.
Corrections and failure retries
Banning every later call would prevent correction of proven errors; selecting a better response after failure would instead create best-of bias.

Separate two paths: an incorrect command, version, judge, or reference supersedes the declared scope and is rerun; an ordinary failure may use at most one retry declared before measurement, retaining both physical calls and unconditionally using the final one.
Retries are not enabled for the current 1,050 results, and the diagnostic reruns for issue #66 do not replace official results; future protocols may enable retries when needed.

releases.title: 增加同题方法组合对比，修复大输出卡顿
releases.summary: 结果分析页新增两方法差异和多方法交集；超过 256 KiB 的完整证据不再自动插入页面，改为按需加载或直接下载。正式任务、调用、判定、分数和耗时均未改变。
changes: 同题方法对比
旧页只能按方法或结果筛选 1,050 条调用，难以直接找到 A 成功而 B 失败、共同成功、共同失败或多方法分歧的任务。
新增两方法差异与多方法交集；每行沿用同一任务的已核验主判定，并链接到各次标准答案、实际返回和失败原因。
这是集合分析，不产生新分数，也不把不同成功样本的耗时混在一起比较。
大证据加载
超过百万字符的输出自动下载并写入 pre 元素时，会长时间占用主线程，页面表现为卡死。
超过 256 KiB 的文本先显示按需入口；用户点击后使用只读文本框承载完整内容，原始文件下载始终保留。
只改变浏览器呈现时机和控件；发布包内证据字节及校验值不变。
版本与样本边界
Moli 1.1.3 比 1.1.1 少两题可能被直接解读成版本能力回退；京东偶尔可打开也可能被用来否定正式失败。
三轮配对诊断将瞬时请求、页面不稳定和当前主榜成绩分开；京东保留为网络与会话敏感的挑战样本。
当前主榜未启用失败重试，也不用诊断调用挑选更好响应；后续可预先声明失败重试，已证实的错误可按完整范围纠正并替换权威逻辑结果。

en.title: Add matched-task method comparisons and fix stalls on large outputs
en.summary: The analysis page now includes two-method differences and multi-method intersections. Complete evidence larger than 256 KiB is no longer inserted automatically and instead loads on demand or downloads directly. Official tasks, calls, verdicts, scores, and latency values are unchanged.
changes: Matched-task method comparison
The old page could only filter 1,050 calls by method or result, making it difficult to find tasks where A passed and B failed, both passed, both failed, or several methods disagreed.
Add two-method differences and multi-method intersections. Each row reuses the reviewed primary verdict for the same task and links to every reference answer, actual output, and failure reason.
This is set analysis: it produces no new score and does not mix latency from different passing samples.
Large-evidence loading
Automatically downloading an output of more than a million characters and inserting it into a pre element occupied the main thread for a long time, making the page appear frozen.
Text larger than 256 KiB first shows an on-demand control. After a click, the complete content is placed in a read-only text box; the original-file download is always retained.
Only browser presentation timing and controls change; evidence bytes and checksums in the release bundle are unchanged.
Version and sample boundaries
Moli 1.1.3 passing two fewer tasks than 1.1.1 could be read directly as a capability regression, while JD.com occasionally opening could be used to dismiss the official failure.
Three paired diagnostic rounds separate transient requests and page instability from the current primary ranking. JD.com remains a challenge sample sensitive to network and session state.

The current primary ranking does not enable failure retries or use diagnostic calls to select better responses. Future runs may predeclare failure retries, while proven errors may be corrected across their complete scope and replace the authoritative logical results.

releases.title: 迁移到 Sites，并固化评测报告工作流
releases.summary: 报告迁移到新的 Sites 域名并保留原站点；仓库新增跨评测类型的报告 Skill，覆盖评测设计、证据、独立核验、影响范围重跑和发布门禁。任务、输出、分数和耗时不变。
changes: 发布目标
旧发布脚本固定使用 artifact-hub.dev 域名，换会话可能继续更新旧站点。
当前报告配置同时绑定 Sites 服务地址和站点 ID；发布、验证和正文链接从同一配置读取，目标不一致时拒绝更新。
新站点为 UUAhhQMnrGwm；旧站点 bWkRP157EtF6 和 UeZE1vfcEOrM 均未覆盖。
发布身份
仓库 .env 中的旧发布令牌可能优先于用户目录的新 Sites 令牌，导致已授权后仍返回 401。
发布与验证脚本不再加载评测 .env，只读取显式进程环境或用户级令牌；设备授权时会备份不同的旧令牌。
只改变发布凭据来源，不改变任何 provider 调用或报告数据。
跨评测工作流
既有 benchmark-editorial 只负责正式解读文章，无法约束评测设计、评分核验、选择性重跑和报告发布。
新增 benchmark-report Skill，并由根 AGENTS.md 强制路由；规则适用于 Web Fetch、Browser Use 及其他系统对比，不绑定本报告页面结构。
这是流程和维护门禁；本轮主结果仍为 1,050 条，同窗测速仍为 140 条，未重新调用 provider。

en.title: Migrate to Sites and formalize the benchmark-report workflow
en.summary: The report moved to a new Sites domain while retaining the original sites. The repository now includes a report skill spanning benchmark types and covering evaluation design, evidence, independent review, impact-scoped reruns, and publication gates. Tasks, outputs, scores, and latency values are unchanged.
changes: Publication target
The old publication script hard-coded the artifact-hub.dev domain, so a new session could continue updating an old site.

The current report configuration binds both the Sites service address and site ID. Publishing, verification, and body links read the same configuration, and an update is rejected if the targets disagree.
The new site is UUAhhQMnrGwm; neither old site, bWkRP157EtF6 or UeZE1vfcEOrM, was overwritten.
Publishing identity
An old publication token in the repository .env could take precedence over the new user-level Sites token, causing 401 responses even after authorization.
Publishing and verification scripts no longer load the evaluation .env; they read only the explicit process environment or user-level token, and device authorization backs up a differing old token.
Only the source of publication credentials changes; no provider call or report data changes.
Cross-benchmark workflow
The existing benchmark-editorial skill covers only formal interpretation articles and cannot govern evaluation design, score review, selective reruns, or report publication.

Add the benchmark-report skill and require routing through it from the root AGENTS.md. Its rules apply to Web Fetch, Browser Use, and other system comparisons without depending on this report's page structure.
This is a workflow and maintenance gate. The run still contains 1,050 primary results and 140 same-window latency results; no provider was called again.

releases.title: 固定默认报告证据与实测路线
releases.summary: 默认重建现在只接受七方法、150 题和 1,050 条主调用的当前证据。机器可读路线改为本轮实际使用的原生 Markdown、Moli 自动原始响应和 node-html-markdown 2.0.0；分数、调用输出和耗时不变。
changes: 默认重建
默认证据目录仍是旧的十二方法评测，新会话可能在没有报错的情况下生成另一份报告。
将已核验的七方法证据设为 current，并增加独立的当前报告配置文件；构建和证据检查会拒绝方法、数量、截止时间或路线不匹配的证据。
主结果仍为 1,050/1,050 条核验，同窗测速仍为 140/140 条核验；旧证据移入 research 目录保留。
路线元数据
下载数据仍把 Chromium 转换器写成已淘汰的 pyhtml2md 1.7.0，也没有写明三个 Moli 版本处理直接文档和媒体的路线。
路线说明改为与运行器共用的当前定义：普通网页使用各自原生正文能力，Moli 直接文档和媒体使用自动原始响应，Chromium 使用 node-html-markdown 2.0.0。
只更正非判定元数据；任务、参考、输出、分数和耗时均未变化。
复发门禁
核验轮次依附在某一条版本记录中，新增版本时容易让核验页变空；通用 Moli 文件适配器仍可能给二进制响应附加 --dump html。
核验轮次改为独立的结构化记录并在构建时校验；Moli 直接文件统一使用裸 fetch；文档命令统一使用锁定的 uv 运行入口。
页面只展示每轮范围、发现、纠正和未完成项；不增加核验结果下载。

en.title: Pin the default report evidence and measured routes
en.summary: Default rebuilds now accept only the current evidence for seven methods, 150 tasks, and 1,050 primary calls. Machine-readable routes now reflect the native Markdown, Moli automatic raw responses, and node-html-markdown 2.0.0 actually used in this run. Scores, call outputs, and latency values are unchanged.
changes: Default rebuild
The default evidence directory still pointed to the old twelve-method evaluation, so a new session could silently generate a different report.

Set the reviewed seven-method evidence as current and add a separate current-report configuration file. Build and evidence checks reject evidence whose methods, counts, deadlines, or routes do not match.
Primary-result review remains 1,050/1,050 and same-window latency review remains 140/140; old evidence is retained under the research directory.
Route metadata
Download data still identified Chromium's converter as the retired pyhtml2md 1.7.0 and did not state how the three Moli versions handled direct documents and media.

Route descriptions now share the runner's current definitions: ordinary pages use each method's native body capability, Moli uses automatic raw responses for direct documents and media, and Chromium uses node-html-markdown 2.0.0.
Only non-verdict metadata is corrected; tasks, references, outputs, scores, and latency values are unchanged.
Regression-prevention gate
Review rounds were attached to one release record, so adding a release could empty the review page; the generic Moli file adapter could also still append --dump html to binary responses.
Review rounds are now independent structured records validated at build time. Moli direct files consistently use bare fetch, and document commands consistently use the locked uv runtime entry point.
The page shows only each round's scope, findings, corrections, and outstanding items; no review-result download is added.

releases.title: 完成七种方法实测、全量核验与同窗测速
releases.summary: 七种方法均完成同一组 150 个任务，共 1,050 次主调用；另有 20 题 × 7 种方法的 140 次同窗测速。Codex 任务代理在看不到机器结论和分数的条件下逐条核验 1,190/1,190 份输出，最终与当前评分一致，未决 0。
changes: 七方法完整矩阵
新增 Moli 1.0.6 后，旧的六方法分母和版本对比已不完整。
七种方法各执行 150 个相同任务，每个方法—任务组合保留一个权威逻辑结果；Moli 1.0.6、1.1.1、1.1.3 分列。
通过数依次为 Moli 1.1.1 135、Moli 1.0.6 134、Moli 1.1.3 133、Chromium 125、Lightpanda 119、Obscura 117、Kitesurf 112；总数只表示本评测集覆盖，不替代六类分榜。
独立核验账
只检查失败项会漏掉假阳性，旧详情也曾把排版差异误判成内容缺失。
Codex 任务代理逐条读取任务契约、标准答案和完整实际输出，主结果核验 1,050/1,050，同窗测速核验 140/140；机器结论和分数在独立判定前隐藏。
当前自动假阴性 0、自动假阳性 0、未决 0；challenge-08、动态引文字段边界、飞书表格及直接文档路线等历史问题均以当前统一规则重算或重测。
同窗测速
主矩阵来自多个执行批次，远程网络、排队和本地资源竞争使跨批次耗时不能公平排名。
另取 20 个预声明、域名互异的网页，同一窗口并行执行七种方法；延迟只比较全部方法共同通过的 8 个相同任务。
Moli 1.0.6 的样本 P50 最低；8 题属于探索性小样本，P95 只作样本诊断，不外推为稳定尾延迟或 SLA。
参考与路线纠正
live-025 曾误用初始 HTTP 字节作为动态页面标准；Moli 直接 PDF/媒体若强加 --dump 会在取回产物前失败。
live-025 改用独立浏览器渲染后的可见正文并重测七种方法；三个 Moli 版本对直接 PDF、DOCX 和媒体 URL 使用裸 fetch，正文题计入本地解析，文件题直接验收字节。
标准、输入输出目标与评分入口对所有方法一致；各方法仍可使用自己最快的正式原生产物路径。
document-03 参考替换
旧 W3C PDF 地址在本轮变成 Cloudflare 验证页，继续使用会把站点拦截误当作 PDF 解析能力。
改用 Mozilla PDF.js 固定 Git 提交中的三页 PDF，并重新调用七种方法；未变化的 1,043 条主结果及核验保持原样。
Moli 1.0.6、1.1.1 取得全部三页文字并通过；Moli 1.1.3 单次请求失败，其他方法未取得可读正文。该单次结果不能单独证明版本回归。
标题诊断
标题指标先展示定义和空表，读者看不到输入、对齐和汇总过程。
按读取条目、详情链接对齐、逐标题比较、可比结果汇总四步展示；没有可对照标题时明确显示不适用，不生成空表。
标题诊断仍不参与任务通过判定，也不代表榜单召回、实时性或整页正文质量。
环境与复现
旧环境页复述每个批次，账号页又容易让人误以为报告应保存正式密钥。
环境和复现合并，只保留版本、二进制哈希、部署边界、配置文件和锁定命令；账号页仅列所需账号、变量名和官方获取入口。
正式密钥只从仓库本地 .env 读取，不进入 HTML、Git 或发布包；Kitesurf 的托管后端版本和本地部署不可复现边界单独披露。

en.title: Complete seven-method measurement, full review, and same-window latency testing
en.summary: All seven methods completed the same 150 tasks for 1,050 primary calls, plus 20 tasks × 7 methods for 140 same-window latency calls. A Codex task agent reviewed 1,190/1,190 outputs without seeing machine verdicts or scores; the final decisions agree with current scoring, with 0 unresolved.
changes: Complete seven-method matrix
After Moli 1.0.6 was added, the old six-method denominator and version comparison were incomplete.
Each of the seven methods runs the same 150 tasks, retaining one authoritative logical result per method-task pair; Moli 1.0.6, 1.1.1, and 1.1.3 are listed separately.

Pass counts are Moli 1.1.1 135, Moli 1.0.6 134, Moli 1.1.3 133, Chromium 125, Lightpanda 119, Obscura 117, and Kitesurf 112. The totals show coverage of this dataset only and do not replace the six family rankings.
Independent-review ledger
Reviewing only failures would miss false positives, and old detail pages also mistook layout differences for missing content.

A Codex task agent read every task contract, reference answer, and complete actual output. Primary-result review covers 1,050/1,050 and same-window latency review covers 140/140; machine verdicts and scores were hidden until after the independent decision.

Current automated false negatives are 0, false positives are 0, and unresolved items are 0. Historical issues including challenge-08, dynamic-quote field boundaries, the Feishu table, and direct-document routes were rescored or rerun under the current shared rules.
Same-window latency test
The primary matrix spans several execution batches, so remote networking, queuing, and local resource contention prevent fair cross-batch latency ranking.
Use 20 predeclared pages on distinct domains and run all seven methods in parallel within the same window. Latency is compared only on the same 8 tasks passed by every method.
Moli 1.0.6 has the lowest sample P50. The 8 tasks are a small exploratory sample, and P95 is only a sample diagnostic, not an estimate of stable tail latency or an SLA.
Reference and route corrections
live-025 incorrectly used the initial HTTP bytes as the reference for a dynamic page. For direct PDFs and media, forcing --dump on Moli fails before the artifact is retrieved.

live-025 now uses visible body text rendered by an independent browser, and all seven methods were rerun. The three Moli versions use bare fetch for direct PDF, DOCX, and media URLs; body tasks include local parsing, while file tasks validate bytes directly.
References, input-output targets, and the scoring entry point are identical for every method; each method may still use its fastest official native-artifact route.
document-03 reference replacement
The old W3C PDF URL became a Cloudflare verification page during this run; continuing to use it would mistake site blocking for PDF-parsing capability.
Replace it with a three-page PDF from a pinned Mozilla PDF.js Git commit and call all seven methods again; the unchanged 1,043 primary results and their reviews remain intact.

Moli 1.0.6 and 1.1.1 retrieved all three pages of text and passed. Moli 1.1.3 had a single request failure, while the other methods did not retrieve readable body text. This single result cannot by itself establish a version regression.
Title diagnostics
The title metric previously showed a definition followed by an empty table, leaving its inputs, alignment, and aggregation process invisible.

Show four steps: read records, align by detail URL, compare each title, and aggregate comparable results. When no titles can be compared, explicitly show not applicable instead of generating an empty table.
Title diagnostics still do not determine task acceptance and do not represent ranking recall, freshness, or whole-page body quality.
Environment and reproduction
The old environment page repeated every batch, while the account page could imply that production credentials should be stored in the report.

Combine environment and reproduction, retaining only versions, binary hashes, deployment boundaries, configuration files, and locked commands. The account page lists only required accounts, variable names, and official acquisition sources.

Production credentials are read only from the repository-local .env and never enter HTML, Git, or the release bundle. Kitesurf's hosted backend version and the non-reproducibility of local deployment are disclosed separately.

releases.title: 区分文字存在与字段边界完整
releases.summary: 复核 Quotes 异步列表的两版 Moli 输出：10 条引文和作者均已取得，但相邻字段及多标签之间没有可读分隔。任务结果保持未通过，详情页改为按引文、作者、标签逐字段呈现，避免把边界损失笼统写成文字缺失。
changes: 字段级证据
旧详情把整条稳定记录标成未命中，即使其中引文和作者已经完整出现，读者无法知道真正失败的是标签列表边界。
逐条展示引文、作者和标签的标准答案、实际解析值与判定；标签字符完整但分隔消失时明确标为字段边界不合格。
只修正失败解释和分类，不改变任务契约、原始输出、耗时或分数。
两版 Moli 复核
只看 Moli 1.1.3 会遗漏旧版是否存在同类问题。
Moli 1.1.1 与 1.1.3 的该任务输出逐字节相同，均有 10 条完整且唯一记录；8 条多标签文字粘连，最后一条还混入 Loading 文本。
两版均维持未通过；单标签的第 9 条正常命中，说明规则检查的是标签边界而非引文是否出现。
失败核验覆盖
读者需要区分全量核验与只检查个别版本。
主结果 900/900 全量盲审，包括 Moli 1.1.1 和 1.1.3 各 150 条；184 个机器失败项全部有非空独立审查证据。
各方法失败核验覆盖均为 100%，无未裁定结果。

en.title: Distinguish text presence from intact field boundaries
en.summary: Review two Moli outputs for the asynchronous Quotes list: all 10 quotations and authors were retrieved, but adjacent fields and multiple tags lacked readable separators. The task remains failed, while the detail page now presents quotations, authors, and tags field by field instead of describing lost boundaries broadly as missing text.
changes: Field-level evidence
The old detail page marked an entire stable record as unmatched even when its quotation and author appeared in full, obscuring that the actual failure was the tag-list boundary.

For each record, show the reference, parsed value, and verdict for quotation, author, and tags; when all tag characters are present but separators disappear, explicitly mark the field boundary invalid.
Only the failure explanation and classification are corrected; the task contract, raw output, latency, and score do not change.
Review of two Moli versions
Looking only at Moli 1.1.3 would miss whether the earlier version had the same problem.

The outputs from Moli 1.1.1 and 1.1.3 for this task are byte-for-byte identical, each with 10 complete unique records. In 8 records, multiple tags run together, and the last record also includes Loading text.
Both versions remain failed. Single-tag record 9 matches normally, showing that the rule checks tag boundaries rather than whether the quotation appears.
Failure-review coverage
Readers need to distinguish full review from checks of only selected versions.
All 900/900 primary results were blindly reviewed, including Moli 1.1.1 and 1.1.3 with 150 each. Every one of the 184 machine failures has nonempty independent review evidence.
Failure-review coverage is 100% for every method, with no unadjudicated results.

releases.title: 核对文档参考，纠正等价表格误判
releases.summary: 逐项核对 10 个文档任务的冻结源、完整正文参考、正文分段契约和 60 次实际输出；同时复查飞书帮助文档的表格判定。文档参考没有截断；飞书任务原先把 Markdown 表格语法当成内容要求，造成 3 次误判，现已按相同输入输出目标统一纠正。
changes: 覆盖率展示
位置详情把一小段人工定位样例放在长标准正文旁边，容易被误认为机器只用这段短文本打分。
结果页就地说明分母、分子和完整输入：覆盖率使用上方完整实际返回计算；定位样例只帮助读者人工确认一次命中。
评分实现、保存输出、耗时和分数均未改变。
最小 PDF 范围
document-03 的源文件正文只有 Dummy PDF file，若沿用长文档任务说明，会被误解为参考正文缺失。
报告明确标为最小文档解析样本：冻结源文件全部可提取正文就是 14 个字符，只检查能否取得短 PDF 文字。
该任务不能证明多页、表格或附录能力；六种方法本轮都未取得这 14 个字符，结果仍全部失败。
文档参考审计
嵌入文档任务只保存外围 HTML 时，读者无法追踪完整正文来自哪个 PDF。
document-07 记录查看器实际加载的 PDF、既有冻结文件路径及双重哈希；document-08 记录冻结 HTML 中的嵌入地址、独立下载哈希和提取正文哈希。
10 个文档参考与正文分段契约均核对通过，没有参考截断导致的分数变化。
Moli DOCX 口径
报告把直接 DOCX 写成已经取得原始响应，但本轮 Moli 1.1.3 实际把该 DOCX 序列化为含包字节的 HTML。
方法页改为如实描述自动选择结果：PDF 进入原始响应并解析，DOCX 没有形成可解析原文件并失败。
不增加 curl 等外部兜底，不把其他下载器的成功归给 Moli。
等价表格输出
飞书帮助文档原规则只接受 Markdown 管道表或 HTML table。Obscura 和两版 Moli 已完整返回三列表头及全部表格内容，但按阅读顺序展开为普通文本，因此被误判失败。
删除与目标无关的表格语法限制；继续用 3 个稳定事实、五段正文覆盖和完整文本质量验收，同一规则作用于全部方法。
沿用原始输出和耗时离线重评分，不重跑 provider；3 次结果由失败改为通过。

en.title: Audit document references and correct equivalent-table misclassification
en.summary: Audit all 10 document tasks across their frozen sources, complete body references, body-region contracts, and 60 actual outputs, and recheck the Feishu help-document table verdict. No document reference was truncated. The Feishu task had incorrectly treated Markdown table syntax as a content requirement, causing 3 misclassifications that are now corrected under the same input-output target.
changes: Coverage presentation
Region details placed a short inspection snippet beside the long reference body, making it easy to mistake the snippet for the only text used in machine scoring.

The result page now explains the denominator, numerator, and complete input in place: coverage is computed from the complete actual output above, while the locator snippet only helps readers inspect one match.
The scoring implementation, saved output, latency, and score are unchanged.
Minimal PDF scope
The source body for document-03 contains only Dummy PDF file; reusing the long-document description would make the reference look incomplete.

The report explicitly labels this a minimal document-parsing sample: the complete extractable body of the frozen source is 14 characters, and the task checks only whether short PDF text can be obtained.
This task cannot establish support for multiple pages, tables, or appendices. None of the six methods retrieved these 14 characters in this run, so all results remain failed.
Document-reference audit
When an embedded-document task retains only the surrounding HTML, readers cannot trace which PDF supplied the complete body.

document-07 records the PDF actually loaded by the viewer, the existing frozen-file path, and two hashes. document-08 records the embedded URL in the frozen HTML, the independent-download hash, and the extracted-body hash.
All 10 document references and body-region contracts passed review; no score changed because of a truncated reference.
Moli DOCX description
The report said the direct DOCX was obtained as a raw response, but Moli 1.1.3 actually serialized that DOCX as HTML containing package bytes in this run.
The method page now describes automatic selection accurately: the PDF became a raw response and was parsed, while the DOCX did not become a parseable original file and failed.
No external fallback such as curl is added, and another downloader's success is not credited to Moli.
Equivalent table output

The original rule for the Feishu help document accepted only a Markdown pipe table or an HTML table. Obscura and two Moli versions returned all three column headings and the complete table content, but expanded it as plain text in reading order and were therefore misclassified as failures.

Remove the table-syntax restriction, which is unrelated to the target, while retaining acceptance based on 3 stable facts, five-region body coverage, and complete-text quality. The same rule applies to every method.
Rescore the existing raw outputs and latency offline without rerunning the provider; 3 results change from fail to pass.

releases.title: 纠正文档与资源路线，并完成 900 条结果独立核验
releases.summary: 150 个任务 × 6 种方法共 900 次调用均有明确结果。Moli 1.1.3 的直接文档和媒体改用自动原始响应；Codex gpt-5.6-sol 盲审全部 900 条保存输出，分歧逐条裁定且无未决项。任务详情页直接展示标准答案、实际返回和判定证据。
changes: Moli 1.1.3 正确路线
给直接 PDF 使用 --dump html/markdown 会在取得正文前报错，也无法真实衡量 1.1.3 的原始响应能力。
普通网页仍使用原生 Markdown；直接文档与媒体使用裸 fetch，由 CLI 自动选择原始响应或序列化页面。PDF、PNG、WebM 和 MP4 在本轮取得原始字节，DOCX 被序列化为 HTML 并失败。
只替换受实现影响的 7 个直接文档调用和 3 个直接文件调用；Moli 1.1.3 最终通过 133/150，旧版 Moli 1.1.1 为 123/150。
文档正文与文件分轨
下载到 PDF 或 DOCX 不等于取得正文，反过来正文任务也不应强制所有方法先转成同一种中间格式。
正文任务统一验收可读文字：方法直接给正文即可，只给原文件则把本地解析计入耗时；原始文件任务验收格式、长度和目标 SHA-256，不做无关 Markdown 转换。
当前覆盖 PDF、DOCX、TXT 和嵌入文档；不声称支持旧 DOC、OCR、表格语义或任意办公格式。
全部结果独立核验
只复核自动失败项会漏掉假阳性；文件任务若只交给代理空文本占位文件，也会制造假失败。
Codex gpt-5.6-sol 在看不到机器判定和分数的条件下核对 900/900 条结果；文件任务同时提供真实二进制证据，协议缺陷影响的 3 个批次单独重审。
所有分歧均有可观察证据和最终裁定，0 条未决；同窗测速 120/120 另行全量核验。
统一评分纠错
Markdown 链接边界会让实际存在的 Reddit 社区说明被误判缺失；百分号编码的相对下载地址也会漏判。
可见链接文字按排版边界还原；只把带文件后缀的尖括号相对目标按源页解析并 URL 解码，不把普通文件名 prose 当成地址。
challenge-08 的两版 Moli 假阴性被纠正；Chromium 的 Blender 下载包地址改判通过。原输出、调用状态、耗时和内容哈希均不变。
乱码识别
请求成功和较长输出不能证明文字可读；run-9b35581eb0fdbbdea4a6 含大量替换字符。
统一检测 U+FFFD 的数量与占比，达到显著阈值时判正文解码损坏，并在详情页显示数量、比例和原始输出。
该调用仍为失败，但失败原因由笼统内容缺失改为可核验的解码损坏，不把乱码当有效正文。
任务详情重做
旧页把一份答案的五个位置写成 body-region，标准答案和实际输出又藏在大量表格与折叠项后。
首屏显示任务 ID、方法、运行 ID 和结论；随后直接并排展示完整标准答案与实际返回。位置检查只保留汇总表，具体原文证据按需展开，运行字段统一折叠到页尾。
只改变证据呈现，不修改任何任务、输出、分数或耗时。
版本追溯
运行时版本字符串缺失时，仅写产品名无法证明测试的是哪个构建。
本地实现按二进制 SHA-256 固定：Moli 1.1.1 与官方归档事后逐字节匹配，Moli 1.1.3 和 Chromium 保留运行时版本与哈希；Lightpanda 以精确 nightly 哈希标识。
Kitesurf 是托管服务，服务端构建未公开，报告明确标为不可得，不伪造版本。
证据打包
重新组装相同记录时改变 JSONL 行序会让独立核验哈希失效。
组装器保留源证据顺序，并将参考修订、评分修订和结果核验记录随报告发布。
900/900 指标可从保存输出复现；150 个任务和 6 种方法均无缺项。

en.title: Correct document and resource routes and independently review all 900 results
en.summary: Across 150 tasks × 6 methods, all 900 calls have explicit results. Moli 1.1.3 now uses automatic raw responses for direct documents and media. Codex gpt-5.6-sol blindly reviewed all 900 saved outputs; every disagreement was adjudicated and none remain unresolved. Task detail pages show the reference answer, actual output, and verdict evidence directly.
changes: Correct route for Moli 1.1.3
Using --dump html/markdown for a direct PDF errors before body retrieval and cannot measure the raw-response capability of 1.1.3 accurately.

Ordinary pages continue to use native Markdown. Direct documents and media use bare fetch, allowing the CLI to select a raw response or serialized page automatically. PDF, PNG, WebM, and MP4 returned original bytes in this run; DOCX was serialized as HTML and failed.
Only the 7 direct-document calls and 3 direct-file calls affected by the implementation are replaced. Moli 1.1.3 ultimately passes 133/150, while the older Moli 1.1.1 passes 123/150.
Separate document-body and file tracks
Downloading a PDF or DOCX is not the same as obtaining its body text; conversely, a body task should not force every method through the same intermediate format.

Body tasks uniformly require readable text: direct body output is accepted, while an original file is parsed locally with parsing time included. Original-file tasks validate format, length, and target SHA-256 without an unrelated Markdown conversion.
Current coverage includes PDF, DOCX, TXT, and embedded documents; it does not claim support for legacy DOC, OCR, table semantics, or arbitrary office formats.
Independent review of every result
Reviewing only automated failures would miss false positives. Giving the agent only an empty text placeholder for file tasks would also create false failures.

Codex gpt-5.6-sol reviewed 900/900 results without seeing machine verdicts or scores. File tasks also supplied real binary evidence, and the 3 batches affected by a protocol defect were reviewed separately.
Every disagreement has observable evidence and a final adjudication, with 0 unresolved; all 120/120 same-window latency results were reviewed separately.
Shared scoring correction
Markdown link boundaries could make an existing Reddit community description appear missing, and percent-encoded relative download URLs could also be missed.

Restore visible link text at layout boundaries. Resolve and URL-decode only angle-bracketed relative targets with file extensions against the source page; do not treat ordinary filename prose as a URL.

False negatives for two Moli versions on challenge-08 are corrected, and Chromium's Blender download-package URL is changed to pass. Raw output, call status, latency, and content hashes remain unchanged.
Corrupted-text detection
A successful request and long output do not establish readable text; run-9b35581eb0fdbbdea4a6 contains many replacement characters.
Consistently measure the count and share of U+FFFD, classify the body as decode-corrupted at a material threshold, and show the count, ratio, and raw output on the detail page.
The call remains failed, but its reason changes from generic missing content to verifiable decode corruption; garbled text is not treated as valid body text.
Task-detail redesign
The old page labeled five regions from one answer as body-region, while hiding the reference answer and actual output behind numerous tables and disclosure controls.

The first screen shows task ID, method, run ID, and conclusion, followed by the complete reference answer and actual output side by side. Region checks retain only a summary table, source evidence expands on demand, and run fields are grouped in a disclosure at the end.
Only evidence presentation changes; no task, output, score, or latency value is modified.
Version traceability
When the runtime version string is missing, a product name alone cannot establish which build was tested.

Local implementations are pinned by binary SHA-256: Moli 1.1.1 was matched byte for byte to the official archive afterward; Moli 1.1.3 and Chromium retain runtime versions and hashes; Lightpanda is identified by its exact nightly hash.
Kitesurf is a hosted service whose server build is unpublished; the report marks it unavailable instead of inventing a version.
Evidence packaging
Changing JSONL row order while reassembling the same records invalidates independent-review hashes.
The assembler preserves source-evidence order and publishes reference revisions, scoring revisions, and result-review records with the report.
The 900/900 metric is reproducible from saved outputs; none of the 150 tasks or 6 methods is missing.

releases.title: 完成五种浏览器最快 Markdown 路线的 750 次实测
releases.summary: Kitesurf、Lightpanda、Obscura、Moli 使用原生 Markdown，Chromium 使用渲染 DOM 加 node-html-markdown 2.0.0；150 题 × 5 种方法全部执行、独立参考生命周期与离线复评分全部通过。
changes: 方法口径
旧草稿把五种方法强制写成相同 HTML 转换链路，掩盖了原生接口优势。
对齐 URL、Markdown 输出、任务集、验收规则和 45 秒截止；每种方法使用最快的正式或自带 Markdown 路线。
Kitesurf 走 Cloudflare 账号版 /markdown；三种本地 CLI 走原生 Markdown；只有无原生 Markdown 的 Chromium 做 DOM 转换。
Chromium 路线
旧 pyhtml2md 路线在大页面上转换慢，且普通网页少通过一题。
以同一批已保存 DOM 对候选转换器复评分，采用 node-html-markdown 2.0.0，并保留 HTML、版本、哈希和转换耗时。
本轮 Chromium 普通网页 98/100；转换属于客户端端到端耗时，不冒充浏览器原生能力。
历史判定审查
旧规则会漏判跨 Markdown 链接换行、原生接口链接排版、排版空白和部分动态表达，也曾放行过不完整正文。
逐条对照 750 条保存输出、标准答案和任务契约，统一修正 43 个假阴性与 1 个假阳性；run-f4e6f2ee641e8baa9e3d 确认是误判。
修正规则对所有方法生效，不增加 provider 特例；原输出、调用身份和耗时不改。
同步 main
上游任务规则与报告缺陷修正会影响旧结论。
合并最新 main 后复查影响范围；Django 教程参考变化，对五种方法全量同题重跑，其余仅在参考字节和评测契约等价时复用。
Moli 该题新调用 browser exit，普通网页结果为 93/100；不沿用旧通过。
公平性
远程 Kitesurf、本地进程、不同 readiness 条件和转换时间可能被误读为纯内核性能。
速度只在双方共同通过的相同 URL 上配对，并明确客户端端到端边界。
结果不能推出同机 CPU/RSS、网络剥离后的引擎速度、持续吞吐、成本或 SLA。
任务可识别性
案例详情页只显示标题，读者无法从页面确认任务 ID。
案例页首屏与逐次调用页均显示稳定任务 ID；运行 ID、规则、参考与输出继续可追溯。
展示改动不改变任务、结果或分数。
发布隔离
本报告与旧报告用途不同，覆盖旧站点会破坏历史链接。
发布目标固定为独立站点 bWkRP157EtF6。
旧站点 UeZE1vfcEOrM 保持不变。

en.title: Complete 750 measured calls on the fastest Markdown routes of five browsers
en.summary: Kitesurf, Lightpanda, Obscura, and Moli use native Markdown, while Chromium uses a rendered DOM with node-html-markdown 2.0.0. All 150 tasks × 5 methods were executed, and the independent-reference lifecycle and offline rescoring both passed.
changes: Method contract
The old draft forced all five methods through the same HTML conversion chain, obscuring the advantage of native interfaces.
Align URLs, Markdown output, task set, acceptance rules, and the 45-second deadline; each method uses its fastest official or built-in Markdown route.
Kitesurf uses the account-level Cloudflare /markdown route; three local CLIs use native Markdown; only Chromium, which lacks native Markdown, converts the DOM.
Chromium route
The old pyhtml2md route converted large pages slowly and passed one fewer ordinary web task.
Rescore candidate converters on the same saved DOM batch, adopt node-html-markdown 2.0.0, and retain the HTML, version, hash, and conversion latency.
Chromium passes 98/100 ordinary web tasks in this run. Conversion is included in client end-to-end latency and is not presented as a native browser capability.
Historical-verdict review
The old rules missed line breaks across Markdown links, native-interface link layout, layout whitespace, and some dynamic expressions, and had also accepted incomplete body text.

Compare all 750 saved outputs individually with their reference answers and task contracts, correcting 43 false negatives and 1 false positive under shared rules; run-f4e6f2ee641e8baa9e3d is confirmed as misclassified.
The corrected rules apply to every method without provider-specific exceptions; raw outputs, call identities, and latency values do not change.
Sync with main
Upstream task-rule and report-defect corrections can affect earlier conclusions.

After merging the latest main, review the affected scope. Because the Django tutorial reference changed, rerun the matched task for all five methods; reuse other results only when reference bytes and evaluation contracts are equivalent.
The new Moli call for this task exits the browser, leaving its ordinary-web result at 93/100; the old pass is not retained.
Fairness
Remote Kitesurf, local processes, differing readiness conditions, and conversion time could be misread as pure engine performance.
Pair speed only on identical URLs passed by both methods and state the client end-to-end boundary explicitly.
The results cannot establish same-machine CPU/RSS, network-excluded engine speed, sustained throughput, cost, or an SLA.
Task identification
Task detail pages showed only titles, so readers could not confirm task IDs from the page.
Both task pages and per-call pages now show stable task IDs immediately; run IDs, rules, references, and outputs remain traceable.
The presentation change does not alter tasks, results, or scores.
Publication isolation
This report serves a different purpose from the old report, and overwriting the old site would break historical links.
The publication target is pinned to the separate site bWkRP157EtF6.
The old site UeZE1vfcEOrM remains unchanged.

releases.title: 完成文件任务评测，建立报告完整性发布门槛
releases.summary: 36 次文件任务全部实际调用并判定：Moli 与 Crawl4AI 各通过 3 次，共 6 次通过、30 次未通过、0 次未测。整份报告的 1,800 个计划调用均有唯一结果和明确判定。
changes: 文件任务
旧记录没有保存原文件字节，不能判定直接 PNG、WebM 和 MP4 是否取得。
十二种方法各执行 3 个文件案例；最终配置对应的 36 次调用全部进行格式、长度和目标 SHA-256 验收。
Moli 与 Crawl4AI 各通过 3 次，其余 30 次未通过；未通过保留为真实结果，不删除有效困难案例。
原生接口范围
只测正文路径会漏掉产品公开提供的原生文件能力，并把局部配置误当成产品能力。
Moli 文件任务使用原文件字节输出；Crawl4AI 文件任务预先选择其原生 HTTP crawler，正文仍使用浏览器路径。
按任务开始前固定的公开接口评测，不做失败后兜底，也不把普通 HTTP 下载冒充 provider 结果。
计时边界
“耗时”没有清楚区分服务端时间、下载、渲染、本地加工和报告处理。
统一以客户端端到端计时：从发起 provider 调用到形成可评分最终答案；下载、渲染、提取、输入转换及文件哈希均计入。
评分、证据落盘、限速等待和报告生成不计入；供应商服务端耗时不参与排名。
完整性门槛
以实际调用数作分母会让缺少计划调用的 8/8 看起来完整；两个覆盖列也重复。
改为“判分完整性 = 已明确判定数 / 计划调用数”，并检查每个 provider × case 恰有一个当前结果。
任一缺失、重复或无法判定都会在报告全局高亮为不可靠；完整性检查、报告校验与发布打包均阻止不完整结果发布。
证据呈现
成功文件保存在包内但不易从调用页直接核验，变更页又堆叠多次同日修订。
成功调用页提供文件下载、格式、字节数和 SHA-256；同日修订合并为一个正式版本，较早版本折叠。
只改善审计入口与阅读结构，不修改原始文件、分数或耗时。
首页结构
类别概览藏在详细榜单之后，读者需要先穿过大表格。
六类任务概览前置，直接列出样本数、完整判分的方法数、最高任务通过率及对应方法；详细榜单留在后方。
不同类别任务要求不同，最高分不能跨类别直接比较。

en.title: Complete file-task evaluation and establish a report-completeness publication gate
en.summary: All 36 file-task calls were actually made and judged: Moli and Crawl4AI each pass 3, for 6 passes, 30 failures, and 0 unmeasured. Every one of the report's 1,800 planned calls has a unique result and explicit verdict.
changes: File tasks
Earlier records did not retain original-file bytes, so retrieval of direct PNG, WebM, and MP4 files could not be judged.
Each of the twelve methods runs 3 file tasks; all 36 calls in the final configuration are validated by format, length, and target SHA-256.
Moli and Crawl4AI each pass 3 calls, while the other 30 fail. Failures remain real results, and valid difficult tasks are not removed.
Native-interface scope
Testing only body-text routes would miss publicly offered native file capabilities and mistake a partial configuration for product capability.
Moli file tasks output original-file bytes. Crawl4AI file tasks preselect its native HTTP crawler, while body tasks retain the browser route.
Evaluate the public interface fixed before the task begins, without post-failure fallback or presenting an ordinary HTTP download as a provider result.
Timing boundary
Latency did not clearly distinguish server time, downloading, rendering, local processing, and report processing.
Use one client end-to-end timing boundary: from starting the provider call until a scoreable final answer exists. Downloading, rendering, extraction, input conversion, and file hashing are included.
Scoring, evidence persistence, rate-limit waits, and report generation are excluded; provider server-side latency is not ranked.
Completeness gate
Using actual calls as the denominator could make 8/8 appear complete despite missing planned calls; two coverage columns were also redundant.
Change to “judgement coverage = explicitly judged calls / planned calls” and require exactly one current result for every provider × case.
Any missing, duplicate, or unjudgeable result marks the entire report unreliable; completeness checks, report validation, and release packaging all block publication of incomplete results.
Evidence presentation
Successful files were retained in the bundle but difficult to verify directly from call pages, while the changelog stacked several same-day revisions.
Successful-call pages provide file downloads, format, byte count, and SHA-256. Same-day revisions are merged into one official release, with earlier releases collapsed.
Only audit access and reading structure improve; original files, scores, and latency values do not change.
Overview structure
The family overview was hidden after detailed rankings, forcing readers through large tables first.
Move the six-family overview forward and list sample count, methods with complete judgements, highest task pass rate, and the corresponding methods directly; detailed rankings remain later.
Task requirements differ by family, so top scores cannot be compared directly across families.

releases.title: 统一验收口径，纠正参考、成绩与报告结论
releases.summary: 保留 150 个案例、1,800 条原始调用；92 条任务判定改变，36 条缺少文件字节证据的历史记录从误记失败改为未测。原始输出和耗时不变。
changes: 正文参考
CSS 标准正文目录被误删，Django 文档混入站点外围内容。
按独立保存的源页面重新确定正文边界，并记录来源与参考哈希。
全文 F1 随参考修正；旧低分不能直接归因于供应商正文噪声。
统一评分
明确的名称—链接字段和合法 Markdown 软换行没有统一进入验收。
所有方法共用同一答案转换和评分入口，排除请求回显与诊断日志。
修正格式导致的假失败，不按 provider 名称设置评分分支。
正文覆盖
只检查开头关键词和最小长度可能让极短摘录通过长文任务。
有完整独立参考的任务增加最多五个连续区域的词语覆盖检查。
它是内容覆盖下限，不替代全文 F1，也不保证语义或事实正确。
动态字段
商品任务要求的分期和配送字段没有被完整验收。
按独立参考检查字段归属、数量、类型和唯一性；易变价格与排序不冻结为永久答案。
字段齐全不等于变化值真实或最新。
截止时间
超出登记预算的结果仍可能计为成功。
新调用采用统一端到端截止；历史记录仅按已登记耗时和预算重判。
不声称历史调用当时已经受新硬截止控制。
文件缺测
36 条没有字节证据的文件记录被当成失败。
先改为未测并退出通过率分母，随后在 2026-09-04 通过真实 provider 调用补齐。
不以 URL、文本或其他方法的下载结果代替原方法文件证据。
结果解读
不同成功子集的条件耗时被直接当成同题速度，部分文章结论超出证据。
增加共同通过子集诊断，并明确单次、跨批次与参考范围限制。
不能从本轮样本外推全网能力、稳定性或生产 SLA。

en.title: Unify acceptance criteria and correct references, scores, and report conclusions
en.summary: Retain 150 tasks and 1,800 original calls. Verdicts change for 92 tasks, and 36 historical records lacking file-byte evidence change from incorrectly recorded failures to unmeasured. Raw outputs and latency values are unchanged.
changes: Body references
The CSS reference body's table of contents was incorrectly removed, while the Django document included surrounding site content.
Redetermine body boundaries from independently saved source pages and record provenance and reference hashes.
Full-text F1 changes with the corrected references; earlier low scores cannot be attributed directly to provider body-text noise.
Shared scoring
Explicit name-link fields and valid Markdown soft line breaks were not handled consistently in acceptance.
All methods share one answer transformation and scoring entry point, excluding request echoes and diagnostic logs.
Correct format-induced false failures without scoring branches keyed by provider name.
Body coverage
Checking only opening keywords and minimum length could let a very short excerpt pass a long-document task.
For tasks with a complete independent reference, add token-coverage checks across up to five contiguous regions.
This is a minimum content-coverage requirement, not a replacement for full-text F1 or a guarantee of semantic or factual correctness.
Dynamic fields
Required installment and delivery fields in the product task were not fully validated.
Check field ownership, count, type, and uniqueness against independent references; volatile prices and ordering are not frozen as permanent answers.
Complete fields do not establish that volatile values are accurate or current.
Deadline
A result exceeding the registered budget could still count as successful.
New calls use a shared end-to-end deadline; historical records are rejudged only from their registered latency and budget.
The report does not claim that historical calls were originally controlled by the new hard deadline.
Unmeasured files
36 file records without byte evidence were treated as failures.
First mark them unmeasured and remove them from the pass-rate denominator, then fill them with real provider calls on 2026-09-04.
Do not substitute a URL, text, or another method's download for the original method's file evidence.
Interpreting results
Conditional latency from different passing subsets was treated as matched-task speed, and some article conclusions exceeded the evidence.
Add diagnostics for the jointly passing subset and state single-run, cross-batch, and reference-scope limitations explicitly.
This sample cannot establish internet-wide capability, stability, or a production SLA.
